units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 20:14">Targ. Y. Lev. XX, 14</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 64a:7">Snh. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>שדיוהו וכ׳</he> cast ye him into a kettle (of lead) <he>וכסיוהו וכ׳</he> and cover him with lead (or heavy load; ed. <he>שדיוה</he> incorr.; Ms. M. omits <he>דאברא</he>; oth. var. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).
<cite ref="Gittin 19a:13">Git. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>בא׳</he> (writing) with lead pencil, <he>במיא דא׳</he> with a solution of lead.
